## What's new

- **Kultr now needs iOS 26 or later.** Its look is built on iOS 26's Liquid Glass. Supporting iOS 17 and 18 meant keeping a second copy of the tab bar, the glass effects and the buttons, about 400 lines that only older iPhones ran. That copy is gone. If your iPhone runs iOS 17 or 18, keep 1.3.7.

## What's fixed

- **Pulling the full player down is smooth.** The first pull often stuttered and jumped. While the player moved, Kultr redrew everything in it, including the cover, the progress bar and the queue, and blurred a shadow the size of the screen, for every frame of your finger's movement. Now only the card moves, and its contents stay as they are. It also follows your finger from the start instead of jumping about 15 points.
- **A beat-matched song keeps its tempo to the end.** After an InjeKt mix, a song plays at the tempo it was matched to. If the next transition was a plain crossfade, Kultr used to reset the song to normal speed as the crossfade began. Now no song changes speed partway through.

## Under the hood

- **About 340 lines of code that no longer did anything are gone.** That includes InjeKt's old tempo-blending mode, which eased the playing track toward the next one's tempo. It hasn't run since 1.3.1, and its two settings were already hidden. Ending and cancelling a mix, seeking, starting downloads and the download buttons on the Sync and Downloads screens each existed twice; each now exists once. A dozen unused leftovers are deleted.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac), **Feather** or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
